title: A2A Utilities Module
summary: This module provides essential utility functions and configuration models for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including agent card generation, signature verification, gRPC interception, and task management.

nodes.label: Get Default Update Config
nodes.title: Retrieve Default Update Configuration
nodes.description: Retrieves the default configuration for A2A update mechanisms, typically returning a StreamingConfig instance for communication updates.

nodes.label: Deprecated A2A Configuration
nodes.title: A2A Protocol Configuration (Deprecated)
nodes.description: Defines the configuration for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol integration, including endpoint, authentication, timeouts, and update mechanisms. This class is deprecated and will be removed.

nodes.label: A2A Client Configuration
nodes.title: Remote A2A Agent Client Configuration
nodes.description: Specifies the configuration for connecting to remote A2A agents, covering endpoint details, authentication, timeouts, response models, and supported extensions for client-side interactions.

nodes.label: Convert Agent to AgentCard
nodes.title: Generate AgentCard from Agent
nodes.description: Transforms an Agent instance into an AgentCard, which describes the agent's capabilities and metadata for A2A communication, enabling other agents to understand its functions.

nodes.label: Convert Crew to AgentCard
nodes.title: Generate AgentCard from Crew
nodes.description: Generates an AgentCard from a Crew instance, detailing the crew's collective capabilities, agents' roles, and available skills for A2A interactions, representing the crew as a single entity.

nodes.label: Verify AgentCard Signature
nodes.title: Validate AgentCard JWS Signature
nodes.description: Validates the JSON Web Signature (JWS) of an AgentCard using a public key, ensuring its authenticity and integrity for secure A2A communication and trust establishment.

nodes.label: gRPC Auth Metadata Plugin
nodes.title: gRPC Authentication Metadata Injection
nodes.description: A gRPC authentication metadata plugin that injects authentication headers into gRPC calls as metadata, facilitating secure communication between services.

nodes.label: gRPC Unary-Unary Interceptor
nodes.title: Intercept Unary-Unary gRPC Calls
nodes.description: Intercepts unary-unary gRPC calls to inject authentication or other metadata before the call proceeds, ensuring consistent metadata application for single request/response.

nodes.label: gRPC Unary-Stream Interceptor
nodes.title: Intercept Unary-Stream gRPC Calls
nodes.description: Intercepts unary-stream gRPC calls to inject authentication or other metadata, used for requests that send a single message and receive a stream of responses.

nodes.label: gRPC Stream-Unary Interceptor
nodes.title: Intercept Stream-Unary gRPC Calls
nodes.description: Intercepts stream-unary gRPC calls to inject authentication or other metadata, used for requests that send a stream of messages and receive a single response.

nodes.label: gRPC Stream-Stream Interceptor
nodes.title: Intercept Stream-Stream gRPC Calls
nodes.description: Intercepts stream-stream gRPC calls to inject authentication or other metadata, used for requests that send and receive streams of messages, enabling bidirectional communication.

nodes.label: Configure JSON Logging
nodes.title: Setup Structured JSON Logging
nodes.description: Sets up structured JSON logging for the A2A module, replacing default handlers to provide machine-readable log output for easier analysis and integration with log management systems.

nodes.label: Execute Task with Extensions
nodes.title: Run A2A Task with Extension Hooks
nodes.description: Executes an A2A task for a given agent, integrating server-side extension hooks for custom processing, tool injection, or prompt augmentation, enhancing task flexibility.

nodes.label: Monitor Task Cancellation
nodes.title: Watch for A2A Task Cancellation
nodes.description: Monitors for task cancellation events, either through a pub/sub mechanism (like Redis) or by polling, to gracefully terminate ongoing A2A tasks and manage resources efficiently.

groups.label: A2A Configuration Management
groups.title: A2A Configuration Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and managing the configuration settings for Agent-to-Agent communication, including client-side and deprecated server-side configurations.

groups.label: Agent Card & Identity
groups.title: Agent Card Generation and Verification
groups.description: Functions for creating AgentCards from individual agents or crews, and for verifying the digital signatures of these cards to ensure authenticity and integrity in A2A interactions.

groups.label: gRPC Communication Interception
groups.title: gRPC Interceptors and Authentication
groups.description: Components that provide gRPC client-side interception capabilities for various call types (unary, stream) and a plugin for injecting authentication metadata into gRPC requests.

groups.label: Task Execution & Monitoring
groups.title: A2A Task Execution and Cancellation
groups.description: Utilities for executing A2A tasks with integrated extension hooks and for monitoring cancellation events, ensuring robust and manageable task lifecycles.

groups.label: System Utilities
groups.title: A2A System Utilities
groups.description: General utility functions for the A2A module, such as configuring structured JSON logging for improved observability and debugging.
